gripOrHq.title: Hostile Takeover
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

gripOrHq.title: Project Consultants
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add four advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate War
gripOrHq.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

gripOrHq.title: Haunting Inquisition
gripOrHq.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

gripOrHq.rulesText: Look at the top five cards of R&D and arrange them in any order you choose.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: The cost to install ice on this fort is reduced by [2].

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

discardCards.title: Finders Keepers
discardCards.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

discardCards.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

rig.title: Rent-I-Con
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: Invisibility
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.
